Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange Mass Spectrometry (HDX-MS) study. While HDX-MS is a specialized proteomics technique, it does not map to the specific PTM-enrichment modifiers (like phospho or ubiquitin) provided in the ontology. The acquisition was explicitly DDA.

scope: A pET45b plasmid containing the PPARγ-LBD, residues 230–505 as well as an N-terminal 6× His tag and tobacco etch virus nuclear inclusion protease (TEV) recognition site was transformed into BL21 (DE3) gold cells
Initial protein purification was performed on either an AKTA start (GE Healthcare) or a NGC Scout (Bio Rad) FPLC using 2 His Trap FF 5–ml columns in series
Size exclusion chromatography was then performed using a Hiload 16/600 Superdex 75 pg column
Protein purity in excess of 95% was confirmed by sodium dodecyl sulfate polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis.
HDX-MS samples were prepared the same as NMR samples.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry (HDX-MS) was performed on purified PPARγ LBD protein and its complexes with ligands and peptides, as detailed in the protein purification and NMR sample preparation sections. PRIDE metadata mentioning 'bile' is likely an error and is contradicted by the experimental methods describing recombinant protein expression in E. coli.
